## Workload

During the quarter, grader Marcus Bell completed 890 reads, recording 458 hours of work. This represents a rate of 1.9 reads per hour. The workload figures provide a clear summary of activity during the review period and indicate the volume of work completed against the hours recorded.

## Quality

A total of 61 reads were checked as part of the quality review. The agreement result was 68.9 per cent. Feedback was provided on borderline background cases to support consistent interpretation and future grading decisions.

Reviewer Priya Anand completed the review. The findings should be considered alongside the workload information, as the quality check covered a sample of the completed reads and identified areas for further attention.
